about: S2 汴河 · 運河兩岸 (the canal wharves): who speaks and what (the life pass, gen/life/progress.md; brief gen/life/brief_section.md; format tools/talk_data.mjs; pilot sections/outer_road/talk.json). scenes: near talks (press E at the host; `as` = the line for who you play, `again` = the next talk with the same host). chatter: groups that talk among themselves when you are within earshot. barks: a lone figure's word now and then (`close`: a call to you as you come near). Every role is a painted figure of people.json; every line cites its reading (src: 名画记 7-17, 余辉 2014/2015/2021/2023, 東京夢華錄, the map, or our proposal); 繁體, no numbers on screen; lines fit the figure's clips (sleepers only think). Plot-line steps told here: grain.1 (V2.1 again, c2.grain), grain.2 (c2.sacks), horse.3 (V2.2, c2.donkey), qingming.2 (V2.3, b2.rider). Bundled by tools/ui_data.mjs into web/public/assets/ui/talk.json.

scenes.title: 倉前成市
scenes.reading: 名画记 9 仓前成市: porters unload sacks that look like grain at the wharf and stack them neatly; the owner, after the long voyage, sits on the bales, a little tired. 余辉 2015 看点四 and 2021: every grain boat in the painting is private, with no grain official or armed guard at the unloading; the merchants carry it to private granaries in the lanes and hoard it for a good price. The map: the owner sits on his sacks pointing, mouth open; a bearded man with folded hands watches; a youth with a topknot behind the pile; the tally men east of him. Chosen: 余辉's private grain (私粮进京) with 名画记 9's tired owner; the tally sticks are our proposal.

scenes.title: 城鄉交界

The map: a round-faced smiling man on a stool holds the lead of a dark donkey; a bearded man on a bench leans over its back, hands at its neck; a diner at the next table looks on. That the travellers bring the news of the bolting horse (the horse thread) and that the leaning man is calming the donkey is our proposal.

scenes.title: 王家紙馬

The map: a hooded rider on a donkey stopped facing the signboard (王家纸马, illegible on our scan, read by 名画记 13 and Hansen). people.json casts the rider as a woman in a veiled hat (帷帽): our reading. scenes.title: 逆水行舟
scenes.reading: 名画记 15 逆水行舟: the outermost boat, heavy-laden in a crowded channel, so master and crew are tense: a boatman poles her off the moored boats, two stand ready with poles, the master directs at the bow, seemingly shouting a warning to the boats ahead; three passengers (one on the roof's fore end, one pacing in the stern shed, one half out of the stern cabin); at the front cabin's window a woman with a child, the most relaxed on board. The map: a robed man with a pointer on the foredeck (the master: our reading), a boatman fending off 豪华客船, the bowman, men hauling and minding lines on the roof, a passenger and a smaller figure at the window, a man in the stern cabin's door. The map reads the window passenger as a man and our cast is a man and a youth, so their lines stay neutral. 余辉 2015 看点三: the mast must come down before the Rainbow Bridge.
